summary: Enhance your industrial control systems with our Lead SCADA Security Manager. Discover best practices for safeguarding your SCADA infrastructure today.
audienceIntro: This PECB Certified Lead SCADA Security Manager course is essential for professionals who are responsible for the security, integrity, and resilience of industrial control systems and critical infrastructure. It is designed for individuals seeking to lead and implement comprehensive SCADA security programs. This course is designed for: Security professionals acquiring specialized SCADA security skills. IT professionals enhancing technical knowledge in ICS environments. IT and Risk Managers seeking deep understanding of SCADA systems. SCADA system developers integrating security by design. SCADA engineers and operators managing system vulnerabilities. SCADA IT professionals overseeing operational technology networks. Compliance officers ensuring regulatory adherence for critical infrastructure. Cybersecurity consultants advising on industrial control system protection. Incident response team members handling OT security breaches. Auditors assessing the effectiveness of SCADA security controls.
modules: Introduction to SCADA and ICS Security
Designing SCADA Security Programs and Network Architecture
Implementing ICS Security Controls and Incident Management
prerequisites: A fundamental understanding of SCADA Security is recommended to maximize your learning experience in this course.
